name: voice_comfort
title: Voice comfort
summary: Makes Mary's voice slower, faster, quieter or louder, and switches between Mary and Sam.
instructions: Use when they ask you to talk slower, faster, quieter or louder, or to switch between Mary and Sam. If they say you cut them off or ask for more time to finish, use more_time; if they say you can answer faster, use less_time. The resident can't use their hands well, so do these when asked by voice. Then ask if that is better.

actions.name: slower
actions.description: Make Mary's voice a little slower.

actions.name: faster
actions.description: Make Mary's voice a little faster.

actions.name: quieter
actions.description: Make Mary's voice a little quieter.

actions.name: louder
actions.description: Make Mary's voice a little louder.

actions.name: more_time
actions.description: Wait longer before answering, when they say you cut them off.

actions.name: less_time
actions.description: Answer a little quicker, when they say you can answer faster.
